known_facts_book1: The girl Ruler of Oz, who reigns from the Emerald City and is Dorothy's dearest friend.
Grants Dorothy's request to live in Oz and invites Uncle Henry and Aunt Em to live there too.
Uses the Magic Belt to transport Dorothy and then her uncle and aunt from Kansas to the Emerald City.
Watches the Nome King's plot unfold in her Magic Picture and learns of the coming invasion.
Refuses to arm her people or fight, unwilling to cause bloodshed even to defend her kingdom.
Refuses to flee to Kansas with the Magic Belt, vowing to share her people's fate.
Meets the invaders at the Forbidden Fountain and, after they forget, gently sends the Nome King home.
Has Glinda make the whole Land of Oz invisible to outsiders forever after.

known_relations_book1.Dorothy: Her chosen companion, whom she has made a Princess of Oz.
known_relations_book1.Nome King: Her enemy Roquat, who plots to conquer Oz and enslave her; she once captured his Magic Belt.
known_relations_book1.Glinda: The good Sorceress whose counsel she seeks and who works the spell that hides Oz.
known_relations_book1.Scarecrow: Her adviser, who devises the plan to defeat the invaders at the Fountain.
known_relations_book1.the Wizard: Her court wizard, now learning true magic from Glinda.

known_facts_book1: The great good Sorceress of Oz, who commands the spirits and lives near the country of the Quadlings.
Long ago placed the Water of Oblivion in the Forbidden Fountain to make a wicked King forget his wickedness.
Built and protects the walled rabbit city of Bunnybury and made the paper town of the Cuttenclips.
Has been teaching the Wizard real magic since he settled in the Emerald City.
Advises Ozma that no more outsiders should be allowed to find Oz.
Works a Magic Spell that makes the entire Land of Oz invisible to all eyes but its own, cutting it off from the world.
Reveals she had already performed the spell before Ozma even arrived, knowing her wishes.

known_relations_book1.Ozma: The Ruler she advises and serves; she hides Oz at Ozma's wish.
known_relations_book1.the Wizard: Her pupil, whom she is teaching to be a genuine wizard rather than a humbug.
known_relations_book1.Dorothy: Whom she knows well and who invokes Glinda's name in Bunnybury.

known_facts_book1: The little Wizard of Oz, once a humbug from Omaha, now learning true magic from Glinda the Good.
Asks to join Dorothy's tour and brings his black bag of magic tools in the red wagon.
Conjures full furnished tents and hot meals from handkerchiefs and an empty kettle by Glinda's trick.
Notices Dorothy's footprints and Billina's tracks and tracks her to the sign-post, making camp until she returns.
Guides the wagon party on through Rigmarole Town and the Flutterbudgets toward the Tin Woodman's castle.

known_relations_book1.Glinda: His teacher, who is making him a real wizard instead of a humbug.
known_relations_book1.Dorothy: His travelling companion, whom he finds after she is lost.
known_relations_book1.Ozma: The Ruler he serves in the Emerald City.
known_relations_book1.Sawhorse: The wooden steed that draws his red wagon on the tour.
